meta.datasetTh: หน่วยงานรัฐ
meta.what: office sites: the buildings of an office spread over several buildings, one point inside each building
meta.sheetTitle: CityMETER Government Office Thailand — รายชื่อรอยืนยัน 2026-11-05

tab.name: 07_SITE_BOUNDARY_CHECK
tab.digestRule: SHA-256 of [columns, …the checked rows] as canonical JSON (siteTabDigest)
tab.readMethod: the checked rows of the build's columns, from the run that wrote the tab (scripts/sites-browser.js), proven equal to the sheet's cells by siteTabDigest on the sheet's page (digest and the whole tab's text SHA-256 8ac6dd2b…)

meta.rule: a checked row of the site tab publishes the interior points of the buildings the map draws inside the office's site (an OpenStreetMap area of the office matched by place and name; the buildings whose point stands in it); the map shows the buildings holding those points as the office's site. The frame, the match and the notes stay in the sheet.

sources.osm_polygon: กรอบพื้นที่ OpenStreetMap

meta.licenceScope: the site groups: a database derived from OpenStreetMap areas (and OpenStreetMap buildings where the map draws them)
meta.externalRule: a site of another CityMETER dataset that names a row here (go = the row's key) replaces this sheet's site only when its boundary_source ranks higher; an equal rank keeps this sheet's
excludedFields: boundary_evidence_url of frame-only sites (OpenStreetMap element pages)
name, type and district (data/offices.json has them)
